title: TriggerCoverageChangedPayload
description: Payload of the TriggerCoverageChanged event (model/architecture/events.yaml; INV-REQ-788; class: domain). One stored row of ingestion.trigger_coverage for an entity and a trigger class (event-carried state transfer). The tenant travels in the CloudEvents envelope. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

triggerClass.description: The trigger class whose coverage changed.

adapterRef.description: The adapter the class is mapped to. Present when status is MAPPED.

reviewDate.description: The review date of the waiver. Present when status is WAIVED.

coveringSolution.description: The other solution that covers the class. Present when status is COVERED_BY_OTHER_SOLUTION.

evidenceReference.description: The evidence of the other solution (INV-REQ-1322). Present when status is COVERED_BY_OTHER_SOLUTION.

actorUserId.description: The id of the acting user, never a role.
